# Ezekiel 36 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 36:9 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | For behold-Me toward-you, and-I-will-turn to-you, and-you-will-be-tilled and-sown. |
| LOGOS | For behold, I am for you, and I will turn to you, and you shall be tilled and sown. |
| PNEUMA | I am on your side! I will come to help you, and your land will be plowed and planted again. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 36:14 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Therefore, humans you-will-not-devour anymore, and-your-nation you-will-not-bereave anymore," declares the-Lord YHWH. |
| LOGOS | therefore you shall no longer devour people and no longer bereave your nation of children, declares the Lord GOD. |
| PNEUMA | But you will never again devour people or rob your nation of children, says the Sovereign LORD. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 36:18 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-I-poured-out My-wrath upon-them for the-blood which they-poured-out upon the-land and-[because]-with-their-idols they-defiled-it. |
| LOGOS | So I poured out My wrath upon them for the blood that they had shed in the land, for the idols with which they had defiled it. |
| PNEUMA | So I poured out my fury on them because of the murders they committed and the idols that contaminated the land. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 36:24 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-I-will-take-you from-the-nations and-gather-you from-all the-lands and-bring-you to your-own-land. |
| LOGOS | I will take you from the nations and gather you from all the countries and bring you into your own land. |
| PNEUMA | I will gather you from among the nations and bring you home to your own land. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 36:34 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-desolate-land will-be-tilled, instead-of being-a-desolation before-the-eyes-of everyone passing-by. |
| LOGOS | And the desolate land shall be tilled, instead of being the desolation that it was in the sight of all who passed by. |
| PNEUMA | The formerly desolate land will be farmed again, no longer lying empty for everyone to see. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 36:4 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Therefore, mountains-of Israel, hear the-word-of the-Lord YHWH: Thus says the-Lord YHWH to-the-mountains and-to-the-hills, to-the-ravines and-to-the-valleys, to-the-desolate wastes and-to-the-cities-that-are-forsaken, which became a-prey and-a-mockery to-the-rest-of the-nations all-around — |
| LOGOS | therefore, O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD: Thus says the Lord GOD to the mountains and the hills, the ravines and the valleys, the desolate wastes and the deserted cities, which have become a prey and derision to the rest of the nations all around, |
| PNEUMA | So listen, mountains of Israel, to the message of the Sovereign LORD. He speaks to the mountains and hills, the ravines and valleys, the ruined wastelands and deserted towns that have been looted and mocked by surrounding nations. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
